Carol Sudhalter first pursued a career in biology but eventually followed her passion for jazz. She has played flute and saxophone with Latin Fever, Etta Jones and Chico Freeman, and recorded numerous CDs as a leader. Carol founded the Astoria Big Band and is a member of the Jazz Journalists Association.
Carol was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan. I’m very pleased to have Carol Sudhalter with me. Thanks for making the trip into town today.
